description: This Kotlin file defines the FavoritesActivity class, which displays the user's favorite recipes list, manages UI interactions such as opening recipe details, toggling favorites, and updating the view based on the favorite recipes data.

classes.name: FavoritesActivity
classes.description: Android activity displaying a list of user's favorite recipes with the ability to view details and toggle favorites.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and binds data to the RecyclerView.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes the list when the activity resumes.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates the adapter with the latest favorites and refreshes the empty view state.

methods.name: updateEmpty
methods.description: Shows or hides the empty state TextView based on the item count.

methods.name: openDetails
methods.description: Starts the RecipeDetailActivity to show recipe details.
